Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
In simple terms, the main options are:
Invisalign clear aligners: Clear, removable trays made with SmartTrack™ material, designed for comfort and controlled tooth movement.
Traditional braces: Another teeth-straightening option that uses brackets and wires rather than removable clear trays.
Other clear aligners: Invisalign differs from other clear aligner options through its materials, technology, and clinical experience.
Doctor-guided treatment: Invisalign treatment starts with an Invisalign-trained doctor, who assesses your smile and discusses which treatment options may suit you. Some doctors may also recommend treatment accessories, depending on your needs.
If you have missing teeth or larger gaps, your doctor may also discuss whether a pontic—an artificial tooth attached to an aligner—could be suitable.
